groups.definition: Unsettled law on ownership of AI-generated or AI-embedded technology may cause the company to lose or be unable to enforce IP rights.

Third parties, including non-practicing entities, may assert patent, copyright or other IP infringement claims (including from AI use), leading to damages, injunctions, redesigns, licensing costs or indemnification obligations.

groups.canonical_name: Misappropriation and theft of company IP
groups.definition: The company's proprietary technology, trade secrets and trademarks may be stolen, copied or counterfeited by insiders, hackers or others, eroding competitive advantage.
